normal.name: Cai's Home
normal.text: Talking about the quality of a remake is a good conversation to have in its own right, but if your focus is on keeping old games alive and encouraging people to play them, that approach really isn't ever going to work. I think it's always best to take a game on its own terms.

normal.name: lex luddy
normal.text: 2018 was peak "Bad Times for Lexi," and this trailer actually made me cry. When the game came out, I was in a deeply bad place that I remember very little about in 2026, but finishing that game for the first time is seared into my brain. The closest thing you will get to a "Perfect Video Game."
